name: huntapi-mcp
description: HuntAPI media download API for Claude.
long_description: Download video and audio from public media URLs, or extract their metadata, with one async REST API.

tools.name: audio_download
tools.description: Download audio from a URL via HuntAPI and receive a job id.

tools.name: jobs
tools.description: Poll status, progress (0–100), and result of an async HuntAPI job.

tools.name: media_metadata
tools.description: Extract metadata from a media URL without downloading the file.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Infrastructure health for an engine or endpoint over the last hour. Not scoped to your account or tenant. Enabled per account: HTTP 403 means contact support to activate it.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Retrieve real-time usage statistics and credit balance for your Huntapi account.

tools.name: wait_for_job
tools.description: Wait for an async download job to finish.
